message_index.description:
Zero-based index of the message that supports the memory.

{minimum: 0}
message_index.title: Message Index

quote.description:
Words copied exactly from that message. Never paraphrase a quote.

{minLength: 1}
quote.title: Quote

mention_text.description:
The name exactly as written in the message. Do not expand or correct it.

{maxLength: 1000, minLength: 1}
mention_text.title: Mention Text

message_index.description:
Zero-based index of the message that contains the mention.

{minimum: 0}
message_index.title: Message Index

content.description:
One clear, self-contained statement of the memory, grounded in the source.

{minLength: 1}
content.title: Content

title.description: A short label for lists, 2 to 8 plain words, such as 'Call Priya about rent' or 'Idea: dynamic shopping list'. Tasks start with a verb. No quotes, no remarks such as 'as written'.
title.title: Title

confidence.description:
How sure you are that this reading is correct, from 0 to 1.

{maximum: 1, minimum: 0}
confidence.title: Confidence

evidence.description: The messages this memory rests on. At least one.
evidence.title: Evidence

ambiguity.description: What is unclear or could be read differently, or null if nothing is.
ambiguity.title: Ambiguity

temporal.description: Present only when the source contains a time expression for this memory.

financial.description: Present only when the memory involves an amount of money.

entity_mention_indexes.description: Zero-based positions in this output's entity_mentions list of the entities this memory involves. Every value must be a valid position in that list. Use an empty list when the memory involves none.
entity_mention_indexes.title: Entity Mention Indexes

ExtractionDisposition.description:
What the extractor decided to do with a processing unit.

``EXTRACT`` and ``CONTEXT`` both produce memories. ``CONTEXT`` marks material kept
for reference only. ``ABSTAIN`` means the unit does not carry enough information to
form a reliable memory, so nothing is invented and the run is sent to review.
ExtractionDisposition.title: ExtractionDisposition

amount.description: The single amount the note is about: the one stated number, or the result of simple arithmetic written in the message. Use null when there are several separate amounts or when no single amount is clear.
amount.title: Amount

component_amounts.description: Every money amount written in the messages, in order of appearance.
component_amounts.title: Component Amounts

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, only when a currency symbol, code, or name is written in the message. Use null otherwise. Never infer a currency from context or location.
currency.title: Currency

category.description: Short lowercase spending category such as 'food', or null if unclear.
category.title: Category

counterparty.description: Person or merchant the amount relates to, as written, or null.
counterparty.title: Counterparty

calculation.description: The arithmetic exactly as written, such as '232 + 104', or null.
calculation.title: Calculation

MemoryState.description:
Whether the thing a memory describes is stated as pending or completed.

This is separate from ``MemoryStatus``, which is the lifecycle of the record itself.
``DONE`` is only valid when the source explicitly says so: an intention or a plan is
never evidence of completion.
MemoryState.title: MemoryState

expression.description:
The time expression exactly as written, such as 'tomorrow' or 'Jan 14'.

{minLength: 1}
expression.title: Expression

resolved_date.description: The calendar date the expression refers to. Fill it only when the date is fully determined by the expression and the message date. Use null whenever the year, the week, or the day is uncertain.
resolved_date.title: Resolved Date

schema.description: Everything an extractor returns for one processing unit.
schema.title: ExtractionOutput

conversation_title.description: Only for a conversation with the assistant: what the conversation is about, in 2 to 6 words, like a chat title, such as 'Weekend trip to Goa'. Null for notes and imports.
conversation_title.title: Conversation Title
